title: First Place — Power System Cybersecurity Hackathon 2024
text: Won (First Place) the hackathon on the Power System Cybersecurity Hackathon 2024, hosted by the Department of Water Resources Development and Management (WRD&M) at Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, in collaboration with the Centre for Sustainable Energy (CFSE), held on 14–15 October 2024.

title: ANRF International Travel Support
text: Received International Travel Support from ANRF to attend the 50th Annual IEEE Industrial Electronics Society Conference (IECON 2024) in the USA.

title: IEEE Student Travel Grant — MECOM 2024
text: Received IEEE student travel grant for attending IEEE MECOM 2024 conference at Abu Dhabi (UAE) from 17–20 November 2024.

title: Prof. Ned Mohan Memorial Student Travel Award

title: INUP Hackathon Prize
text: Awarded INUP Hackathon prize at the User's Meet, organized by the Indian Nanoelectronics Users' Programme - Idea to Innovation (INUP-i2i) in association with MeitY (GoI) on 10 August 2024.
